response.why: Preacher blocks Preacher — even trade of 2/4 deathtouch creatures (both die because both have deathtouch). This kills their attacker AND preserves my Vampire Token as a body. Gang-blocking (leaf 3) wastes my token for just +1 life. Not blocking loses 2 life AND leaves their Preacher alive.
response.plan: Block their Preacher with my sick Preacher (mutual deathtouch kills). Keep Vampire Token, Bat T on board. Next turn: cast Kaito ({2}{U}{B}), -2 stun Drowner (biggest remaining threat with Curiosity 4/3 waking up). Flash Mastermind EOT.

response.why: Pass upkeep — main phase I have 4 mana to cast Kaito ({2}{U}{B}), which is far more valuable than Drowner: hexproof, becomes 3/4 Ninja on my turns, -2 stuns Curiosity for 2 turns. Casting Drowner or Mastermind here uses 2 mana and delays Kaito. Save Drowner as flash for their turn (stun their Drowner during combat, or blocker vs Curiosity when it wakes).
response.plan: Pass upkeep. Main phase: cast Kaito ({2}{U}{B}), -2 to stun Enduring Curiosity (2 stun counters = 2 turns locked). Attack with Preacher (I have most life = card+lose 1 life). Save Drowner for flash on their turn — stun Curiosity again next turn or block+deathtouch trade.

response.why: Cast Kaito of Nightmares — my most valuable card. Planeswalker with hexproof on my turn (immune to Cut Down/Go for the Throat), becomes 3/4 Ninja on my turns, and -2 stuns Curiosity with 2 stun counters (2 opp turns locked). Draws me cards via 0 ability later. Way stronger than casting Drowner which just stuns once and is a 2/1 body.
response.plan: Cast Kaito ({2}{U}{B}), use -2 to stun Enduring Curiosity (2 stun counters). Combat: attack with Preacher/Bat/Vampire — Kaito is 3/4 hexproof this turn. Hold Drowners for flash on their turn (block+deathtouch, or stun their attackers). Get Kaito to +1 loyalty next turn for emblem.

response.why: Curiosity blocks Preacher — mutual kill (Preacher deathtouch → Curiosity dies, Curiosity 4 damage kills Preacher). Curiosity returns as enchantment (still triggers card draw). Saves 2 life, kills their attacker, preserves Siren. Gang block wastes Siren for same outcome. No block loses 2 life and keeps their Preacher.
response.plan: Block Preacher with Curiosity — both die but Curiosity returns as enchantment (keeps card-draw trigger). Life stays 22. My creatures next turn: Bat, Siren (untaps), Preacher (still tapped from earlier stun?). Continue racing with Bat + Siren flyers + Curiosity draws. Save Drowners for later flash.

response.why: Cast Drowner — 2 mana adds a 2/1 vigilance body AND its ETB stuns their Enduring Curiosity (or other threat), keeping their card-draw engine offline. After Drowner I still have 2 mana for Mastermind post-combat if room. Passing risks opp Sheoldred with no interaction.
response.plan: Cast Drowner ETB stunning their Enduring Curiosity (or Preacher). Main phase 2 / post-combat: cast Mastermind if mana available. Combat: attack Bat + Siren + Preacher (Drowner vigilance = still blocks). Curiosity draws card. Racing 22-14. Sheoldred is biggest threat but Preacher deathtouch trades.

response.why: Attack-all — Bat + Siren + Preacher (3/5 deathtouch). Bat/Siren flying = unblockable, +2 damage minimum + Curiosity draws 2+ cards. Preacher 3/5 deathtouch trades favorably with any ground blocker. Best case: 23-9 unblocked (5 damage + lifelink). Worst case: still 23-12. Racing to victory.
response.plan: Attack Bat + Siren + Preacher. Curiosity draws card per hit — get Kaito to hand. Preacher deathtouch kills whatever blocks it (Drowner/Vampire Token/opp Preacher trades). Mastermind and Drowner sick stay back as blockers. Opp at 14, my flyers push toward lethal in 2-3 turns.

response.why: Play Swamp is strictly best: free land drop, no tempo cost, brings me to 7 mana enabling Kaito ({2}{U}{B}) plus holding up Drowner (2) or GftT (1B) same turn. Kaito now is fine but commits mana before I've dropped my 7th land and locks out flash Drowner. GftT precombat wastes flexibility (opp has no untapped priority threats worth killing right now). Drowner precombat wastes flash — should be held for their EOT/attack step. Pass concedes tempo in a race I'm winning.
response.plan: Play Swamp → cast Kaito, -2 stun opp's biggest untapped threat (or +1 to draw). Combat: swing Bat + Siren (unblockable flying) + Preacher (3/5 deathtouch); hold Drowner and Go for the Throat for opp's Sheoldred/Kaito or EOT stun on Curiosity. Racing 20-13; won't change unless opp drops a lifegainer or hexproof threat that forces me to reprioritize removal.

Kaito is a creature with hexproof on my turn, safe from Cut Down/GftT. Holding 3 mana back preserves GftT (1B) for a Sheoldred/opp Kaito on their turn, plus keeps Drowner flash-castable EOT. Drowner-first risks Cut Down on a mv-2 target. Postcombat I can still deploy Drowner if opp shows no removal, or hold it for their EOT.
response.plan: Cast Kaito → -2 tapped Curiosity (2 stun counters, locked ~2 turns). Hold Drowner + GftT open for Sheoldred/opp Kaito, or flash Drowner EOT tapping another threat and shuffle Curiosity next turn. Racing 20-13.

response.why: Pass upkeep — no benefit to acting before draw. Drowner-in-upkeep candidate has best worst-case (45, leaf 26) but no urgent target now; better to draw first then decide on main. GftT-in-upkeep worst case is leaf 17 (25, Sheoldred lands) — catastrophic. Pass keeps all options open through draw step; act on main phase with 7 mana, GftT for opp Preacher/Sheoldred, Drowner for stun-shuffle.
response.plan: Pass upkeep → draw → main phase (7 mana, 4-card hand). Cast Drowner stunning opp Preacher (Kaito not a creature on my turn, so untargetable by Drowner/GftT). Cast GftT killing opp's other Preacher. Play Island (8 lands). Attack Siren + Preacher deathtouch — Siren unblockable flying, Preacher through opp's remaining blockers with deathtouch trade. Racing 21-11 with lethal window if opp taps for defense.

response.why: Pass draw step. All leaves show life 21 and opp life 11 — no urgent action needed. Passing lets me act on main phase with 7 mana + a Deep-Cavern Bat now in hand (drew from Curiosity trigger of last turn or fresh draw). Bat gives me ETB peek/exile plus flyer for attacking. GftT/Drowner in draw step wastes tempo — same target availability on main phase.
response.plan: Pass draw → main phase (7 mana, hand: GftT + Island + Drowner + Bat). Cast Deep-Cavern Bat first ({1}{B}) — peek opp hand (0 cards — no benefit but adds flyer). Cast Drowner (flash-anytime is main phase too, {1}{U}) stunning opp Preacher. Cast GftT ({1}{B}) on opp Preacher #2. Attack with Bat + Siren + Preacher — Bat + Siren flyers unblockable, Preacher deathtouch trades. Racing 21-11.

response.why: Play Island (leaves 23-36) is best: land drop first is free tempo, gets me to 8 lands enabling any combination of plays. Worst-case in Play Island ~55 (leaf 27 Faerie Mastermind added to opp) — safest. Cast Bat is risky (leaf 55 Sheoldred lands = 40). GftT worst-case leaf 19 = 40 (opp GftT my Preacher first). Drowner is fine but doesn't grow mana. Bat's ETB peek/exile is worthless since opp hand=0.
response.plan: Play Island (→ 8 lands, 4U+4B potential). Then cast Bat ({1}{B}, adds flyer, ETB peek useless with opp 0 cards). Then Drowner ({1}{U}) stunning opp Preacher for shuffle. Then GftT ({1}{B}) killing 2nd Preacher. Attack with Bat + Siren + Preacher: Bat + Siren fly (unblockable — opp's Bat tapped), Preacher deathtouch trades. 3+ damage through. Racing 21-11 with Curiosity draws.

response.why: Animating Reef ({2}{U}{B}) is best — makes Reef a 4/4 deathtouch attacker for the turn while Drowner (2, vigilance) and Siren (1, flying) also swing. That's 7 damage against opp at 10, plus a mill-4 trigger and Curiosity draws on connect. Cut Down is nearly dead — Preacher (P+T=6) and Curiosity (P+T=7) are out of range, only 1/1 vampire tokens qualify (waste). Passing forfeits a full turn of clock while racing 21-10. Best-scoring leaves are animate + weak opp response (Siren or Faerie Mastermind, where Cut Down finally finds a real target); worst are pass/Cut Down into Sheoldred or Anoint with Affliction.
response.plan: Animate Restless Reef with {2}{U}{B}, then attack with Drowner + Siren + Reef for 7 damage (opp 10→3), plus mill 4 and Curiosity triggers on any connect. Racing 21-10 with lethal next turn. Would change my mind only if opp reveals a wrath or bounces Reef mid-combat.

response.why: Sacrifice Map for explore on Reef — best action. Explore reveals top card: if nonland, Reef gets a +1/+1 counter (becomes 5/5 deathtouch), boosting the swing from 6 to 7 damage; if land, free land drop. Either way it's pure value from a token I'd otherwise leave sitting. Passing risks opp Cut Down on Drowner (leaves 0-2), Drowner stun-shuffle on Reef (leaves 6-7), or Mastermind wall for Siren. Cut Down on a vampire remains low-value and eats Kaito or Anoint responses.
response.plan: Sacrifice Map targeting Reef to explore — bump Reef to 5/5 (or free land drop). Then move to combat with Drowner + Reef for 7 damage into opp at 10. Siren stays back (summoning sick). Would change my mind only if opp presents an immediate wrath, bounce, or stun-shuffle threat requiring Cut Down first.

response.why: Attack-none is better. Reef is tapped (from earlier mana use) and can't attack this turn; Siren is summoning sick. Only Drowner can attack, and opp will chump-block with a 1/1 lifelink vampire — Drowner dies, opp gains 1 life (10→11), no Curiosity draw. Preserving Drowner as a blocker for opp's turn (chump Curiosity 4/3 next combat) is worth more than trading it now.
response.plan: Skip combat. Preserve Drowner for opp's turn (blocks Curiosity), keep opp at 10 life. Next turn: draw Sheoldred (kept on top), untap, animate Reef → 5/5 deathtouch, attack with Reef + Siren + Drowner = 8 damage. Curiosity triggers on connect. Lethal or near-lethal within 1-2 turns. Would deviate only if opp reveals a wrath that would take my whole board.

response.why: Best block: Drowner→Curiosity + Siren→Preacher (leaf 5). Life preserved at 21 (no face damage). Both creatures die but Curiosity survives at 4/1 (killable by Cut Down next turn — P+T=5) and Preacher survives at 2/3. Next turn: animate Reef, cast Sheoldred, Cut Down Curiosity (removes opp's engine), attack Reef 5/5. Leaf 1 (Drowner→Curiosity only) is second-best — preserves Siren as flying attacker, Curiosity 4/1 still Cut-Down'able. Worst: no-block (15 life, opp Mastermind adds blocker) or Siren→Preacher (opp Cut Downs Drowner for full board wipe).
response.plan: Block Drowner→Curiosity, Siren→Preacher. Take 0 damage this combat, both trades leave opp's threats at low toughness (Curiosity 4/1, Preacher 2/3). Next turn draw Sheoldred, animate Reef 5/5 deathtouch, Cut Down Curiosity to kill their engine, cast Sheoldred as lifelink stabilizer, and attack with Reef for 5. Race is now 21-10 with opp forced to block or die. Would change my mind only if opp reveals a wrath threat that would consume both creatures anyway.

response.why: Pass upkeep. This is my turn upkeep — draw step follows next, then main phase where I can efficiently animate Reef, cast Sheoldred (drawn from top), and swing. Acting at upkeep wastes information — I don't yet know my draw. Cut Down is dead against opp's board (Preacher 2/4=6, Curiosity is now an enchantment not creature, only vamps are valid targets = waste). Animating Reef at upkeep locks in mana before seeing my draw and opens up Anoint/Cut Down responses from opp on my mana-tapped state.
response.plan: Pass upkeep. Draw Sheoldred, then main phase: cast Sheoldred ({2}{B}{B}), animate Reef ({2}{U}{B}) into 5/5 deathtouch, attack with Reef. Opp's best block sacrifices vampires for lifelink but Reef's deathtouch trades favorably; Sheoldred (summoning sick) provides massive stabilization and drain going forward. Would change my mind only if opp shows they'll animate their Reef in a way I need to counter now.

response.why: Cast Sheoldred, the Apocalypse — best move by wide margin. Sheoldred 4/5 deathtouch is a massive threat + drain engine (opp loses 2 life on each draw). Leaves show opp mirroring with their own Sheoldred (still net neutral for me since I've established a threat), and some leaves resolve to opp_life 8 (drain trigger from opp drawing something). Animating Reef first is worse because opp Go for the Throat kills Reef pre-Sheoldred (leaves 53-56 = disaster). Darkslick Shores is redundant (already have 10 mana). Cut Down remains a wasted removal on 1/1 vampires.
response.plan: Cast Sheoldred, the Apocalypse ({2}{B}{B}) — 4/5 deathtouch on board. Then animate Reef ({2}{U}{B}) into 5/5 deathtouch. Attack with Reef alone (Sheoldred sick). Opp is stuck: block Reef with vamps = they die and lose lifelink potential; don't block = 5 face damage. Sheoldred stabilizes for the long game with drain-on-draw. Would change my mind only if opp reveals a hard counter or wrath in response, but I still have Reef animate to fall back on.

response.why: Animate Reef is best — pushes for the kill. Reef 5/5 deathtouch + Sheoldred 4/5 = 9 damage into opp at 4-6 life = lethal or near-lethal. Cast Preacher adds a body but doesn't advance the kill (sick, can't attack). Passing wastes tempo. Worst-case animate leaves have opp GftT killing Reef, but I still swing Sheoldred for 4 face damage (opp 6→2). Winning either way.
response.plan: Animate Restless Reef with {2}{U}{B} → 5/5 deathtouch. Attack Reef + Sheoldred = 9 damage. If opp GftTs Reef in response, Sheoldred alone for 4 damage puts opp at 2, lethal next turn. Kaito is a planeswalker on my turn (not a creature) and can't block; opp's only blockers are 2 Curiosities + 4 vamps for lifelink chumps.

response.plan: Pass to combat. Attack Reef 5/5 (deathtouch) + Sheoldred 4/5 (deathtouch) = 9 damage into opp at 4-6 life. Opp can chump with vamps for lifelink but 9 power vs their available blockers (2 Curiosities + 4 vamps that all die to deathtouch on trade) still pushes through 3+ face damage minimum. Lethal or forces opp to concede next turn.
